revisions.description: Reads one file from a repository at a branch, tag or commit. Works with a GitHub App installation token (Contents: read) or a personal access token. See https://docs.github.com/en/rest/repos/contents#get-repository-content

params.label: URL
params.helpertext: Defaults to the GitHub API URL the workspace's GitHub integration shares
params.name: url

params.label: Github Access Token
params.helpertext: Defaults to the token the workspace's GitHub integration shares; or enter a personal access token
params.name: token

params.label: Owner
params.helpertext: The organization or user that owns the repository
params.name: owner

params.label: Repository
params.helpertext: The repository name, without the owner
params.name: repo

params.label: File Path
params.helpertext: The file's path in the repository, e.g. config/app.yaml
params.name: path

params.label: Ref
params.helpertext: The branch, tag or commit SHA. Blank is the default branch
params.name: ref

params.label: Output File
params.helpertext: A workspace path to write the file to, absolute or relative to /workspace. Needed for a file over 3000 bytes or one that is not UTF-8 text
params.name: outputFile

results.description: The file's text, when it is UTF-8 and fits in a result (3000 bytes); otherwise empty and the file is in Output File
results.name: content

results.description: The absolute path of Output File, when set
results.name: outputPath
